compiler.validation: source-study lexical probe for bounded text literal

evidence.summary: The compiler reports MNL002 for both quote characters and cannot form a typed text value.
Existing modules provide bounded byte-view scanning and UTF-8 substrate operations, but no owned bounded text representation.

metadata.remainingQuestion: compile-time byte/text literals may solve closed labels before a full bounded text value is justified

reproduction.instructions: Run mncs source-study on the phase6 text-literal probe returning "mncs" as [byte; up_to 64] and inspect MNL002 unsupported source character diagnostics.

summary: Profile 0.18 still has no bounded text value or compile-time text/byte literal. The current text substrate operates on byte views; a direct string literal probe is rejected lexically, so schema and message spellings remain numeric byte arrays or host-owned text.

workaround.description: Applications spell closed schema labels and messages as raw byte arrays or keep open-vocabulary text in host projections.
